CADET.description: Entry-level training. Low noise, simple synthetic anomalies.
CADET.recommended_for: New trainees or early tech school phase.

ANALYST.description: Core analyst mode. Moderate synthetic anomalies, cross-sensor interactions.

SENIOR.description: Senior analyst mode. Multi-domain synthetic stress, drift plus outages.
SENIOR.recommended_for: Flight leads, instructors, or advanced trainees.

EXPERT.description: Expert mode. High-noise synthetic chaos to stress-test judgment and discipline.
EXPERT.recommended_for: Senior NCO / staff-level ISR leads and weapons-school style reps.

recommendation.rationale: Limited training history or low AGI; stay in CADET mode to stabilize fundamentals.
